thesis: Modern freedom negotiates security, consent, autonomy, plural lives and material dependence without erasing either persons or social conditions.

ideas.statement: Neither the self-sufficient individual owing nothing nor the collectivity entitled to everything is defensible; power and obligations require continuing justification.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Consent cannot be retrospectively invented; employment is not simply slavery, protection can become captivity, and radical choice rhetoric can unfairly blame constrained people.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Consent cannot be retrospectively invented; employment is not simply slavery, protection can become captivity, and radical choice rhetoric can unfairly blame constrained people.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read by active LLM; thought experiments, scope and normative distinctions preserved.
